newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: INSIGHT - Dlr/ringgit set to test 2.5250 again.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dlr/ringgit set to test 2.5250 again.

text.p: Dollar/ringgit has again balked at the 2.5250 level but is set for a retest near-term as the recent uptrend remains intact, technical analysts said on Monday.

The uptrend line on the daily chart drawn in from the June 18 low of 2.5080 is providing solid support to any downside. It cuts in at around 2.5220-30 and dollar/ringgit had already tested that area on Monday, they said.
But with overhead resistance pegged at this year's high around the 2.5250-60 level, something has got to give as the rate gets squeezed between the two.

"The market is trapped between that very strong overhead resistance at 2.5250-60 and this solid trendline resistance which currently stands around 2.5220-30," said one Singapore based technical analyst.

A break above 2.5250 would set up a move first to 2.5310, the December 1996 peak, and then 2.5330, the November 1996 peak. The downtrend line on the monthly chart from August 1994 also cuts in at around 2.5330 to reinforce that resistance point.

Psychological support at 2.5200 is still holding, but a break to the downside would target the congestion area around the 2.5150-75 level which also coincides with the 78.6 percent Fibonacci retracement of the November 1996-January 1997 downmove, analysts said.
